description.value:
Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 112. Category: feat. Saiyan Feats.

Requires: Legendary Power Feat, Super Saiyan God,
and Full Power Super Saiyan.
You have mixed Super Saiyan with Super Saiyan God
but it’s different than others, your hair elongates and
your aura shines green with divine energy. You can use
Super Saiyan God as a Power-Up with Full Power
Super Saiyan.
